description: In Los Iros in south Trinidad neatly hidden away in a forest lies a Volcanic Park, home of Erin Bouffe Mud Volcano. The Los Iros Volcanic Park is a wonderful opportunity for a dip in the rejuvenating mud volcano or just relax amidst beautiful surroundings. Listed opening hours: 9 AM - 5 PM. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
